blocks.orig: The Natural Garden Hotel offers 15 rooms, set right on the beach of Jambiani on the east coast of Zanzibar. Palm trees, white sand, thatched roofs, hammocks, handmade furniture, and the bluest blue of two swimming pools and the ocean are what you find here. The rooms boast light colours, natural materials, subtle African art, comfy furniture and ensuite bathrooms. The hotel also has a restaurant with a terrace, and a private villa with its own pool for extra privacy. Guests speak highly of the relaxing massages, the tropical cocktails and the ocean views from the observation deck and the pool. If you want to temporarily forget your daily worries, this is the place to be!
